title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Entry Conditions and Certified Pre-Owned Limits
content:
# Entry Conditions and Certified Pre-Owned Limits

Each coverage type of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage has an entry condition describing the vehicles it is registered on. The Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty adds a certification inspection setting and, by make, the greatest vehicle age and the greatest odometer at certification.

## Entry condition by coverage type

| Coverage type | Entry condition |
|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | a Used Vehicle Retail Purchase deal; registered at delivery |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | vehicle new at its first sale, and the make's term months above zero |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | vehicle new at its first sale |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | vehicle new at its first sale |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | vehicle condition certified pre-owned, with the certification inspection passed |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | vehicle new at its first sale |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | vehicle new at its first sale |

## Certification settings

A passed certification inspection is required to register the coverage where the setting below is Yes.

| Coverage type | Certification inspection required |
|---|---|
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | Yes |
| Every other coverage type | No |

## Greatest vehicle age and odometer at certification, by make

| Coverage type | Figure | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | greatest vehicle age (years) | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 5 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | greatest odometer (miles) | 85,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 | 75,000 | 80,000 |
| Every other coverage type | greatest vehicle age (years) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Every other coverage type | greatest odometer (miles) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Hypothetical points of reference

- A certified Chevrolet with a hypothetical odometer of exactly 75,000 at certification is within the greatest odometer for its make; at 75,001 it is above it.
- A certified Hyundai whose age at certification is exactly 5 years is within the greatest vehicle age for its make; one older than 5 years is above it.
